x: One of our latest police recruits, J. Tebbutt, introduced by Bob Readman, won the Police 6 miles novices race at Regents Park on September 30th in the very fast time of 53 mins. 31 secs. and should prove a great asset to our “ Garnett ” Cup team this season.
Among the new members of the section to distinguish themselves were Jim Tebbutt, Hugh McGreechan, Syd Jarlett and George Checkley, who all look set for successful walking careers.

Another one of our best men, Jim Tebbutt, was on the sick list. This certainly depleted our team, but our lads although beaten by one point for fourth place, walked most gallantly and gave a fine display of team work.
Gregory, was an absentee, as also was Harry Churcher and R. McMullen, and the new title-holder proved to be J. Tebbutt, one of our numerous police walkers.
